name: Gymnastic Ring Push-Up
description: The gymnastic ring push-up is a bodyweight pushing exercise performed with the hands gripping suspended rings, adding significant instability that dramatically increases pectoral, serratus anterior, and stabilizer muscle activation compared to floor push-ups. The rings also allow the wrists to rotate naturally, reducing joint stress and enabling a more natural pressing path.

execution.starting_position: Set the rings at a low height above the floor. Grip the rings and assume a push-up position with arms extended, body in a straight line.
execution.setup_instructions: Adjust ring height so the hands are at the same height as a floor push-up starting position. Lower rings = harder. Feet elevated = harder still.
steps: Step 1: Grip the rings and walk out into a plank position, arms straight.
Step 2: Slowly lower the chest toward the rings by bending the elbows, keeping them from flaring wide.
Step 3: At the bottom, press through the rings and extend the arms while actively turning the rings outward (rings turn from neutral to overhand at the top).
Step 4: At full extension, squeeze the chest and externally rotate the rings for a strong peak contraction.
Step 5: Lower smoothly into the next rep.
execution.breathing_instructions: Inhale as you lower. Exhale as you press up and rotate the rings.
common_mistakes: Allowing the rings to drift far out to the sides, losing stability
Not turning the rings outward at the top — this reduces pec activation
Setting the rings too low without adequate strength
safety_considerations: Establish solid floor push-up form before progressing to rings
Adjust ring height to begin — higher rings = less body weight on arms
Ensure ring straps and anchor point can support bodyweight
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full depth to 90 degrees elbow flexion or below. Full lockout at the top with external ring rotation.
coaching_cues: Turn the rings out at the top like you're trying to show your thumbs to the ceiling
Control the rings — don't let them control you
Tight body from heels to crown
